Customer_Address.table_description: Stores customer addresses, including city, state, country, ZIP code, and contact numbers.

_id.description: Unique identifier for each customer address.

Customer_Address_ID.description: Unique identifier for each customer address.

Customer_ID.description: Foreign key referencing the customer ID in the customer table.

City.description: City where the customer is located.

State.description: State where the customer is located.

Country.description: Country where the customer is located.

ZIP_Code.description: ZIP code of the customer's location.

Primary_Contact_Number.description: Primary contact number for the customer.

Secondary_Contact_Number.description: Secondary contact number for the customer.

Created_Date.description: Date when the customer address was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date when the customer address was last modified.

Customer.table_description: The Customer table stores information about individual customers, including their personal details, contact information, and creation/modification dates.

Customer_ID.description: Unique identifier assigned to each customer.

Created_Date.description: Date and time when the customer record was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date and time when the customer record was last modified (null if not modified).

Customer_View_History.table_description: Stores a history of customer views for products, including the product price and date of view.

_id.description: Unique identifier for each customer view history entry.

Customer_View_History_ID.description: Unique identifier for each customer view history entry.

Customer_ID.description: Identifier for the customer who viewed the product.

Product_ID.description: Identifier for the product viewed by the customer.

Product_Price.description: Price of the product viewed by the customer.

Created_Date.description: Date and time when the customer view history entry was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date and time when the customer view history entry was last modified (currently not used).

Customer_Wish_List_Item.table_description: This table stores items in a customer's wish list, including the product ID, price, and creation date.

_id.description: Unique identifier for each wish list item.

Customer_Wish_List_Item_ID.description: Unique identifier for each wish list item.

Customer_Wish_List_ID.description: Identifier for the customer's wish list.

Product_ID.description: Identifier for the product in the wish list.

Product_Price.description: Price of the product in the wish list.

Created_Date.description: Date when the wish list item was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date when the wish list item was last modified (currently not used).

Customer_Wish_List.table_description: The Customer_Wish_List table stores information about customer wish lists, including the list name, customer ID, and creation date.

_id.description: Unique identifier for each customer wish list.

Customer_Wish_List_ID.description: Unique identifier for each customer wish list.

Wish_List_Name.description: Name of the customer's wish list.

Customer_ID.description: Identifier for the customer who owns the wish list.

Created_Date.description: Date and time when the wish list was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date and time when the wish list was last modified (currently not used).

shipments.table_description: This table stores information about shipments, including their status, delivery dates, and relationships to orders.

shipment_status.description: Current status of the shipment (e.g., Delivered, Shipped, etc.).

order_id.description: Foreign key referencing the order this shipment belongs to.

delivery_date.description: Date when the shipment was delivered.

created_date.description: Date when the shipment was created.

modified_date.description: Date when the shipment was last modified (null if not modified).

invoices.table_description: The invoices table stores information about customer invoices, including payment and order details.

payment_id.description: Foreign key referencing the payment method used for the invoice.

order_id.description: Foreign key referencing the order associated with the invoice.

amount.description: Total amount due for the invoice.

modified_date.description: Date the invoice was last modified (if applicable).

payments.table_description: This table stores payment information for orders, including payment method, status, and date.

order_id.description: Foreign key referencing the order this payment belongs to.

payment_method.description: Method used for the payment (e.g., Debit Card, Bank Transfer).

payment_status.description: Current status of the payment (e.g., Completed, Pending).

created_date.description: Timestamp when the payment was created.

modified_date.description: Timestamp when the payment was last modified (null if not modified).

order_items.table_description: This table stores information about individual items within orders, including the order ID, product ID, quantity, price, and timestamps for creation and modification.

order_items_id.description: Unique identifier for each order item.

order_id.description: Foreign key referencing the order this item belongs to.

product_id.description: Foreign key referencing the product being ordered.

price.description: Total price of the ordered items.

created_date.description: Timestamp when the order item was created.

modified_date.description: Timestamp when the order item was last modified (null if not modified).

Order.table_description: This table stores information about customer orders, including the order date, amount, and associated customer and address IDs.

customer_id.description: Foreign key referencing the customer who made the order.

customer_address_id.description: Foreign key referencing the address associated with the customer who made the order.

modified_date.description: Date the order was last modified (if applicable).

Locality.table_description: The Locality table stores information about different locations, including their area, city, state, country, and zip code.

City.description: The city where the location is situated.

State.description: The state where the location is situated.

Country.description: The country where the location is situated.

ZipCode.description: The zip code of the location.

Created_Date.description: The date when the location was created.

Modified_Date.description: The date when the location was last modified (if applicable).

Product.table_description: The Product table stores information about products in the database, including their name, price, description, category, and creation/modification dates.

Product_Description.example_value: High-quality wireless bluetooth headphones with excellent features and durability. Perfect for both professional and personal use.

Created_Date.description: Date when the product was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date when the product was last modified.

Product_Category.table_description: This table stores product categories with their respective details, including target gender and age groups.

Product_Category_ID.description: Unique identifier for each product category.

Target_Gender.description: Target gender for the product category.

Target_Age_Group_From.description: Minimum age group for the product category.

Target_Age_Group_To.description: Maximum age group for the product category.

Created_Date.description: Date when the product category was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date when the product category was last modified.

Product_Features.table_description: This table stores product features for each product in the database, including feature names and values.

Product_Feature_ID.description: Unique identifier for each product feature.

Product_ID.description: Foreign key referencing the Product table, linking a product to its features.

Product_Feature_Name.description: Name of the product feature, such as 'Color' or 'Size'.

Product_Feature_Value.description: Value of the product feature, such as 'Black' or 'Free Size'.

Created_Date.description: Date and time when the product feature was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date and time when the product feature was last modified (null if never modified).

Product_Image.table_description: This table stores product images along with their creation and modification dates.

Product_Image_ID.description: Unique identifier for each product image.

Product_ID.description: Foreign key referencing the Product table.

Created_Date.description: Date and time when the product image was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date and time when the product image was last modified.

Store.table_description: The Store table stores information about individual retail stores, including their location, name, address, and owner details.

Location_ID.description: Foreign key referencing the Location_ID in the Locality table.

Store_Owner_Phone.description: Phone number of the store owner.

Store_Owner_Email.description: Email address of the store owner.

Created_Date.description: Date and time when the store was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date and time when the store was last modified (null if not modified).

Store_Products.table_description: This table stores information about products available in each store, including stock quantity and dates of creation and modification.

Store_Products_ID.description: Unique identifier for each product-store combination.

Store_ID.description: Identifier for the store where the product is available.

Product_ID.description: Identifier for the product available in the store.

Stock_Quantity.description: Current stock quantity of the product in the store.

Created_Date.description: Date when the product-store combination was created.

Modified_Date.description: Date when the product-store combination was last modified.
